recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a mobile-first browser dress-up game called "Moonlit Stitch Atelier." Preserve the source mechanics exactly: a canvas portrait avatar, category tabs, prev/next wraparound option cycling, current category and variant labels, start overlay, sound toggle, save/lock feedback, and responsive redraw. Transform presentation into a creepy-cute gothic fashion doll atelier inspired by crooked whimsical dark fantasy: stitched doll face, oversized button-like eyes, elongated garment forms, moonlit crooked dressing room, fog, stars, candle/locket UI, bone/gold/rose palette, and concise wardrobe-copy vocabulary. Do not add scoring, timers, loss states, collisions, or new customization rules.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Truth
- genre: portrait dress-up / paper-doll customization studio
- objective: choose category tabs, cycle variants, customize a canvas avatar, and save/lock the finished look
- input model: mobile-safe tap/click buttons for start, sound, save, category selection, previous option, and next option
- core loop: select wardrobe category -> cycle option with wraparound -> canvas redraws avatar -> optional save feedback
- fail/friction state: no loss state; friction is only unavailable/no-change feedback and audio permission constraints

## Protected Mechanics
- 13 customization categories and their option counts are preserved from the old reference.
- Prev/next option cycling preserves wraparound semantics.
- Start overlay, sound toggle, save/lock feedback, category rail, current category label, and variant label remain available.
- Canvas portrait redraw remains immediate after option changes and responsive after resize.

## Safe Presentation Surfaces
HUD vocabulary, fonts, palette, background identity, avatar silhouette, outfit names, feedback copy, procedural props, reaction styling, and media tone are safe to transform because they do not alter customization rules.
